title: Journey Back to Christmas
description: A nurse from World War II is transported in time to 2016 and meets a man who helps her discover the bonds of family and that the true meaning of Christmas is timeless.

title: Hearts of Christmas
description: When a beloved neonatal intensive care unit supervisor is forced to take early retirement, her young colleague, Jenny, decides to turn the staff Christmas party into a surprise bash for her, but the plan is complicated by the hospital's new CFO.

title: Undercover Holiday
description: Returning home for the holidays, pop star Jaylen tells her protective family that Matt is her new beau, when in reality, he's her overzealous security guard.

title: Inventing the Christmas Prince
description: Shelby is about to quit her job as a rocket engineer when her daughter becomes convinced that her Scrooge-like boss is a Christmas prince from a story.

title: Return to Christmas Creek
description: After being told her new holiday app lacked Christmas spirit, a young CEO returns to her hometown to rediscover the meaning of the holidays.

title: Charming Christmas
description: Meredith, the heir to Rossman's Department Store, reluctantly agrees to play the role of Mrs. Claus in a store. When Nick, the new store Santa Claus shows up, she experiences a little holiday magic of her own.

title: Christmas in Evergreen
description: Hoping to spur her longtime beau to action, a small-town veterinarian wishes upon a snow globe that this will be her most romantic Christmas ever.

title: A Christmas Tree Grows in Colorado
description: A woman who is in charge of her town's Christmas celebration must win over a firefighter to obtain a magnificent spruce tree from his property for the festivities.

title: A Season for Family
description: Maddy's adopted son, Wesley, has just one wish for Christmas -- to meet his brother, Cody, who was adopted into a different family. Circumstances soon bring the two siblings together while sparks fly between their respective parents.

title: Angel Falls: A Novel Holiday
description: Book editor Hannah must work with former rival Ryan to help a potential writer find her way, and Angel Anthony reminds them about Christmas spirit and the value of community.

title: A Very Vermont Christmas
description: A local champion skier and Vermont brewmaster team up with an unlikely match to create a seasonal microbrew to save her family's business before Christmas.

title: The Santa Stakeout
description: Two police detectives posing as newlyweds to solve recent holiday party heists are swept up by Christmas while observing the prime suspect.

title: On the Twelfth Day of Christmas
description: Maggie is thrilled when Mitch, her long-time crush, moves back to town. When she learns Mitch's love for Christmas has drastically changed, she tries to bring his holiday spirit back by showing him the magic of Christmas.

title: We Wish You a Married Christmas
description: Taking advice from their marriage coach, a couple visit a quiet town to reconnect during Christmastime.

title: When I Think of Christmas
description: Sara reunites with her ex-boyfriend, Josh, when she returns to her hometown to help her mother move. When Sara makes a surprising discovery, she and Josh forge a bold plan for an upcoming Christmas concert that takes them back to their musical roots.

title: Northpole: Open for Christmas
description: During Christmastime a handyman and an elf persuade a businesswoman to keep the inn that she inherited from her aunt.

title: A Timeless Christmas
description: A man travels from 1903 to 2020, where he meets a tour guide at his historic mansion and gets to experience a 21st century Christmas.

title: My Christmas Family Tree
description: A woman meets long-lost relatives for the first time after discovering her family tree during the holidays.

title: Christmas on My Mind
description: Lucy Lovett wakes up holding a wedding dress and assumes she is about to marry the love her life, Zach Callahan.

title: A Bride for Christmas
description: Aiden (Andrew Walker) bets his friends that he can convince a woman to marry him by Christmas, and he sets his sights on Jessie (Arielle Kebbel), a young woman who has sworn off serious relationships.

title: A Godwink Christmas: Meant for Love
description: A chance meeting at a weekend wedding celebration brings together Alice and Jack, two singles from very different family backgrounds.
